caption: The drawing features two silver-colored spoons, depicted side by side on a plain, light beige background. The spoon on the left is shown with its front side visible, featuring a slightly ornate handle with a double border and an engraved, flowing monogram near the end. The bowl of the spoon exhibits bright white reflective highlights, with shading indicating a metallic gloss. The spoon on the right is displayed with the back side visible, showing a smooth handle tapering toward the end, a maker’s mark with small vertical text on the back of the stem near the bowl, and similar reflective highlights and shading as the first spoon. Both spoons are rendered in shades of pale blue, grey, and white, creating a metallic appearance, and are positioned vertically with their bowls at the top of the composition. Near the bottom right corner of the image, the name “David P Willoughby” appears in light blue text.
title: Silver Tablespoon
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
